svg.title: FinAware — Flow: Log In, Join and FICA Verification
svg.text: FinAware — Flow: Log In, Join and FICA Verification

Step by step, from the login form to the dashboard. Each column is the part of the system doing the work; numbered circles give the order, diamonds are decisions, red boxes are what the person sees when something is refused.
Choose [South African ID] or [Passport] (+ country) and type the
Required; at most 13 characters for an ID, 12 for a passport; letters become
Sends the number, document type, country and authIntent (login or join) to
Look up the number as typed, then in capitals
Zod: it must not be empty
Not checked yet: the SA ID date of birth and check
but sign-up does not use them.
"No account found for this ID/Passport. Use Join Now to create
Nothing is created; no cookies are set
Simulate a new person from the
The same number always gives the same person
(seeded from a hash of the number)
history; a legal record for a judgment or a garnishee
User id, name, risk level, document type and whether FICA is already done
• FICA-verified = 1 if FICA is already done, otherwise 0
• FICA-required = 1 only when joining and not yet verified
Sent back to the login page
Dashboard (or the page they asked for)
Upload an ID document and proof of address (bank statement
optional) — PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 8 MB
or tick [Use demo placeholder FICA documents]
Checks each file's type and size (skipped for the placeholders), then
"You must provide consent to complete FICA verification."
or e.g. "Identity document must be a PDF, JPG, or PNG file."
Zod check (consent must be true), then update the person
Only file names, types and sizes are kept — never
then open the page in ?next= (the Dashboard)
[Log out] — top right on every page
Clears all three cookies — no service call
What the person sees when refused
